title: Independent first jets from an immersive linear system
statement: Let $k$ be algebraically closed, $X$ a scheme locally of finite type over $k$, $\pi:T\to X$ etale, and $t\in T$ a closed point with $\dim_{\kappa(t)}(\mathfrak m_t/\mathfrak m_t^2)\ge2$. Let $U_0\subset X$ be an open containing $\pi(t)$, $L$ an invertible module, $V$ a $k$-vector space with finite basis $b$, and $\psi:V\to\Gamma(X,L)$ a $k$-linear map. Assume the basis sections generate $L$ on $U_0$ and the associated projective morphism is an immersion. Then there are $v_1,v_2,v_3\in V$, an affine neighbourhood $U$ of $t$, a free generator $e$ of $\pi^*L$ on $U$, and coefficients $f_0,f_1\in\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_T)$ of the restrictions of $\pi^*\psi(v_2),\pi^*\psi(v_3)$ relative to $e$, such that $\pi^*\psi(v_1)$ is nonvanishing at $t$, the germs of both coefficients belong to $\mathfrak m_t$, and their classes in $\mathfrak m_t/\mathfrak m_t^2$ are linearly independent over $\kappa(t)$. Scheme conventions are [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], invertibility is [def-sc-invertible-module], generation is [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections], the associated projective morphism is [def-weil-pbc-morphism-to-projective-space-by-sections], tensor pullback is [def-pc-module-pullback], and the etale condition is [def-weil-etale-morphism]. No regularity, smoothness, connectedness, finite-cover assumption, global component, or codimension conclusion is imposed.

proof.text: The image x=pi(t) is closed since X is Jacobson and pi is locally of finite type. The residue maps from k at x and t are bijective by the closed-point field theorem. The rational unramified cotangent criterion, applied to the etale map, makes m_x/m_x^2 -> m_t/m_t^2 surjective.

Choose an affine neighbourhood U of x with a free generator e of L. The source first-jet theorem realizes every a in O_{X,x} modulo m_x^2 as a coefficient of psi(v) in e. Pull e back by the tensor adjunction unit. It is a free generator: compare this adjunction to the native pullback adjunction, whose unit preserves generators. Choose an affine neighbourhood W of t inside pi^{-1}(U) and restrict this generator. Naturality and semilinearity of the unit show that the coefficients of pi*psi(v) are the pullbacks of the coefficients on U.

For q in m_t/m_t^2 lift it through the surjective cotangent map and then through m_x -> m_x/m_x^2. Approximate that element modulo m_x^2 by a source coefficient. The local ring map carries m_x^2 into m_t^2, so its pulled-back coefficient is in m_t and represents q. Approximate 1 in the same way; its pulled-back coefficient differs from 1 by an element of m_t and is a unit. It therefore gives a section nonvanishing at t. Finally choose two independent vectors in the target cotangent space from its finrank bound, lift each by the proved coefficient realization, and use the same W and frame for both sections.

theorem immersiveSystem_local_cotangent_pair
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (π : T ⟶ X) [Etale π]
    (t : T) (ht : IsClosed ({t} : Set T))
    (htdim : 2 ≤ Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (T.presheaf.stalk t))
      (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace (T.presheaf.stalk t)))
    (U₀ : X.Opens) (htU₀ : π t ∈ U₀)
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (V : Type v) [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    (r : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis (Fin r) k V) (ψ : V →+ Γ(L, ⊤))
    (hlinear : ∀ (c : k) (v : V),
      ψ (c • v) = (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv c) • ψ v)
    (hgen : Epi (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback U₀.ι).obj L).freeHomEquiv.symm
      (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin r) ↦ SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv _
        (Scheme.Modules.homOfGlobalSection _
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorSectionsUnit U₀.ι L (ψ (b i.down)))))))
    [IsImmersion (@ProjectiveSpace.homOfGeneratingSections
      (ULift.{u} (Fin r)) inferInstance U₀.toScheme (Spec (.of k))
      (U₀.ι ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k))) ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback U₀.ι).obj L)
      (Scheme.Modules.IsInvertible.of_iso
        (((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction U₀.ι)).leftAdjointUniq
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction U₀.ι)).app L).symm)
      (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin r) ↦ SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv _
        (Scheme.Modules.homOfGlobalSection _
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorSectionsUnit U₀.ι L (ψ (b i.down))))) hgen)] :
    letI : ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback π).obj L).IsInvertible :=
      Scheme.Modules.IsInvertible.of_iso
        (((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction π)).leftAdjointUniq
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction π)).app L).symm
    ∃ (v₁ v₂ v₃ : V),
      t ∈ Scheme.Modules.nonvanishingLocus ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback π).obj L)
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorSectionsUnit π L (ψ v₁)) ∧
      ∃ (U : T.affineOpens) (htU : t ∈ U.1)
        (e : Γ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback π).obj L, U.1)),
        Scheme.Modules.IsFreeGenerator e ∧
        ∃ f : Fin 2 → Γ(T, U.1),
          ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback π).obj L).presheaf.map
              (homOfLE (le_top : U.1 ≤ ⊤)).op
              (Scheme.Modules.tensorSectionsUnit π L (ψ v₂)) = f 0 • e ∧
          ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback π).obj L).presheaf.map
              (homOfLE (le_top : U.1 ≤ ⊤)).op
              (Scheme.Modules.tensorSectionsUnit π L (ψ v₃)) = f 1 • e ∧
          ∃ hf : ∀ i, T.presheaf.germ U.1 t htU (f i) ∈
              IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (T.presheaf.stalk t),
            LinearIndependent (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (T.presheaf.stalk t))
              (fun i ↦ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (T.presheaf.stalk t)).toCotangent
                ⟨T.presheaf.germ U.1 t htU (f i), hf i⟩)
